200.description:
Read one CPSC recall by recall number or RecallID: title, description, dates, products with category and units, hazards, remedies and remedy options, injuries, manufacturers, retailers, importers, distributors, manufacturer countries, UPCs, images and the cpsc.gov notice URL.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `consumer_contact` | string | How consumers reach the firm; null when CPSC lists none. |
| `description` | string | Recall description; null on the rare record without one. |
| `distributors` | string[] | Distributor names. |
| `hazards` | string[] | Hazard statements. |
| `images` | object[] |  |
| `importers` | string[] | Importer names. |
| `injuries` | string[] | Incident and injury statements. |
| `last_publish_date` | string | Date CPSC last published a change to the record. |
| `manufacturer_countries` | string[] | Countries where the products were made. |
| `manufacturers` | string[] | Manufacturer names with location as CPSC writes them. |
| `products` | object[] |  |
| `recall_date` | string | Date CPSC announced the recall. |
| `recall_id` | number | CPSC Recall Central record id. |
| `recall_number` | string | CPSC recall number: two-digit fiscal year plus sequence, with a letter suffix on some 1990-2009 recalls (e.g. 26639, 99079a). |
| `related_urls` | string[] | Related notices CPSC links (Inconjunctions), e.g. Health Canada joint recalls. |
| `remedies` | string[] | Remedy instructions. |
| `remedy_options` | string[] | CPSC remedy categories such as Refund, Repair, Replace. |
| `retailers` | string[] | Where and when the products were sold, as CPSC writes it. |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `title` | string |  |
| `upcs` | string[] | Product UPCs when CPSC lists them. |
| `url` | string | CPSC recall notice URL as CPSC records it; a few historic rows carry typos such as `https:/www.`. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.consumer_contact: Peony Design by email at peonydesigncoshoppe@gmail.com for more information.
value.description: This recall involves Peony Design personalized handmade baby bibs and stroller bags. The bibs have scalloped edges, a snap closure, and personalized embroidery on the front. The bibs were sold in fabric designs of geese, strawberries, heart tulip, plaid checks, and floral print. The stroller bags were made in coordinating fabrics including heart tulip, plaid check, floral print, and Winnie the Pooh. Each stroller bag has two straps with snaps at the ends for attachment and is personalized with embroidery and a ruffle around the top edge.
hazards: The snap can detach from the recalled bibs and stroller bags, posing a risk of serious injury or death from a choking hazard to young children.

images.caption: Recalled bib with plaid check print
Recalled bib with heart tulip print
Recalled Winnie the Pooh stroller bag

injuries: The firm received three reported incidents of a broken snap on a bib and a broken snap on two stroller bags. No injuries have been reported.
manufacturers: Peony Design Co., of Howell, MI

products.name: Personalized Baby Bibs and Stroller Bags

remedies: Consumers should take the recalled baby bibs and stroller bags away from children immediately, stop using them, and contact Peony Design to receive a full refund. Consumers will be asked to discard the recalled baby bibs and stroller bags.
retailers: Online at Etsy.com from October 2025 through July 2026 for between $15 and $45.
value.title: Peony Design Recalls Personalized Baby Bibs and Stroller Bags Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Choking Hazard

post.description: Find recalls for a product, brand, retailer or period. Use recall for the full notice (remedies, units, firms, images). Covers CPSC-regulated consumer products only, not food, drugs, vehicles or tires (FDA, USDA, NHTSA).

cursor.description: Continuation from a previous page (meta.page.next_cursor): the offset of the next recall. Pattern: ^[0-9]+$.

limit.description:
Recalls per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 25.

product_name.description: Substring of a recalled product's name.

product_type.description: Substring of CPSC's product category label, e.g. Cribs, Bicycles.

retailer.description: Substring of the retailer text (where sold), e.g. Walmart, Amazon.

title.description: Case-insensitive substring of the recall title (CPSC RecallTitle).

200.description:
Search CPSC consumer product recalls. Text filters are case-insensitive substrings (stroller also matches strollers); every filter must match. Returns recall summaries newest first with a client-side page and continuation. At least one filter is required; CPSC returns its entire database (10,000+ recalls) otherwise.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `recalls` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hazards` | string[] | Hazard statements. |
| `last_publish_date` | string | Date CPSC last published a change to the record. |
| `manufacturer_countries` | string[] | Countries where the products were made. |
| `product_names` | string[] | Non-empty product names in CPSC order. |
| `recall_date` | string | Date CPSC announced the recall. |
| `recall_id` | number | CPSC Recall Central record id. |
| `recall_number` | string | CPSC recall number: two-digit fiscal year plus sequence, with a letter suffix on some 1990-2009 recalls (e.g. 26639, 99079a). |
| `remedy_options` | string[] | CPSC remedy categories such as Refund, Repair, Replace. |
| `title` | string |  |
| `url` | string | CPSC recall notice URL as CPSC records it; a few historic rows carry typos such as `https:/www.`. |

hazards: The utility wagon violates the mandatory standard for strollers because an opening between the organizational tray and the sidewall may cause a child's head to become entrapped, posing a risk of serious injury or death. In addition, the utility wagon's lack of a restraint system poses a risk of falls to children.
recalls.title: Olympia Tools International Recalls Pack-N-Stroll Utility Wagons Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment and Falls; Violates Mandatory Standard for Strollers
